intro: Our advanced 300 hour yoga teacher training in Rishikesh India is tailored to certified teachers who are prepared to enhance their knowledge and teaching abilities. This course of transformation occurs in the peaceful surroundings of Rishikesh, providing a great atmosphere for delving into yogic studies.

This 300 hour yoga teacher training exceeds typical asana practice by delving into advanced pranayama techniques, meditation, and in-depth exploration of yoga philosophy. You will become proficient in advanced teaching techniques, gain knowledge of therapeutic uses, and enhance your comprehension of yoga scriptures.

Every day you will uncover new findings while delving into complex versions of yoga poses, mastering intricate sequence methods, and grasping the skill of effectively instructing classes with diverse levels. You will also explore advanced meditation techniques, delve into energy-based healing practices, and deeply study classical yoga texts.

After finishing the program, you will have completed the requirement training hours for RYT-500 certification from Yoga Alliance, giving you opportunities to conduct retreats, workshops, and advanced classes around the globe.

curriculum.title: Ashtanga Vinyasa Yoga
items: 1st week – Recap of the Ashtanga Vinyasa Half Primary Series / Memorizing and understanding the sequence to prepare for Mysore practice.

2nd & 3rd week – Mysore-style practice of the Ashtanga Vinyasa Full Primary Series to help each of you develop at your own pace / Led Class of the Ashtanga Vinyasa Full Primary Series / Teaching practice

curriculum.title: Meditation
items: Om Mani Padme Hum Buddha Mantra Meditation
Manipura Chakra (Solar Plexus Chakra) Mantra Meditation
Ajna Chakra (Third Eye Chakra) Mantra Meditation
Yoga Nidra Meditation with Sound Healing Bowls

curriculum.title: Yoga Therapy / Ayurveda
items: Yoga Therapy for Nervous System Issues
Basic Concepts of Ayurveda – Dosha, Dhatus, Mala, Agni, and Ama

curriculum.title: Pranayama
items: Nadi Shodhana Pranayama / Anulom Vilom Pranayama
Surya Bhedana Pranayama / Chandra Bhedi Pranayama

curriculum.title: Yoga Philosophy
items: Shad Darshan (Classification of Indian Philosophy, Aastika & Naastika Darshan)
Introduction of Patanjali Yoga Sutras / 4 Chapter of PYS

curriculum.title: Anatomy / Physiology
items: Brief Introduction of Skeleton System & Function
Anatomy of Shoulder & Function with Important Name of Muscles
Anatomy of Pelvic Griddle with Names of Muscles
Spine Anatomy & Function / Importance in Yoga Practice
Chakra Introduction & Function with the Endocrine System
Nadis – the Energy Channel Function & Importance
Prana Introduction & Importance in Organ Function
Panchakosha Importance in Function of the Body

dining.text: At the Himalayan Yoga Association, we hold our food to the highest standards — not only in taste and nourishment but also in cleanliness, hygiene, and purity. Ingredients are washed with purified water, and our staff are trained to ensure a safe, hygienic, and sacred environment.

arrival: The course starts on 1st of every month at 3:30 pm with the opening ceremony & orientation program, the course completes on 27th of every month at 3:30 pm with certification ceremony. In order for you to rest properly before the opening ceremony on the 1st day of the course, the check-in to the school should be one-day before the course begins. Your check in time must be between 10 AM to 4 PM. We provide you a complimentary stay for that night. Your check out on the last day of the course must be between 12 PM to 2 PM.

The best and most convenient way to travel to Rishikesh is to take a flight to Jolly Grant Airport (Dehradun – DED). Jolly Grant Airport is only about 25 kms from school. As soon as you book your flight, forward us your flight details and we will send our driver to receive you from the airport.
